We hope everyone had a fun summer! 

 We are so excited for the start of the new school year especially since this year we will be hosting our Back to School night, in-person!

There are a lot of exciting events coming up including our welcome back to school community event, Multicultural Potluck! Make sure that you’re following us on Instagram and Facebook to keep up-to-date with school & PTA events.

 

 Save the Dates:

 

●     PTA Meeting: Thursday, September 24th following drop-off

●     Back-to-School Night: Tuesday, September 29th 5:30PM - 8:00PM

○     In-Person!

 More Details Below:

 

PTA Meeting

Thursday, September 24th ~8:30AM 

Gymnatorium

Our first PTA Meeting of the school year is coming up next Thursday, September 24th immediately following drop-off.

PTA Meetings are the perfect chance to learn about upcoming PTA & school events, as well as getting to know how PTA funds are spent throughout the school year to support our students.

Coffee & light snacks will be provided.

We look forward to seeing you there!

 

Back to School Night

Thursday, September 29th from 5:30PM-8PM

School Building

Back to School Night is a chance to speak with your child’s classroom and to learn what the school year will look like. Come learn more about your child’s day-to-day activities, Wit & Wisdom modules, math lessons and more.

This year our Back to School Night will be in-person! Please be on the lookout for information from your classroom teacher.

We will also share more information regarding PTA activities that night, starting next week. 

We look forward to seeing full classrooms!!
